intro: In Westfall, Alba Fairmoon sends an operative to destroy the Defias forge in the Deadmines. The explosives are already planted, and Alba waits in the hills behind Moonbrook for the detonator.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't know what to say, friend. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...
